title: Clarify canonical item identity requirements on retired-check note acknowledgements
outcome: The disposition note acknowledgement contract explicitly binds the canonical work identity when supported and documents or tests any compatible response shape that omits it, with no wrong-item admission.
acceptance: Confirm the producing Engram note receipt contract without guessing, then require canonical work identity where available or define the explicit compatible fallback.
Behavioral acknowledgement tests cover absent, mismatched and correct canonical IDs while retaining unknown/unacknowledged write refusal and no-credit behavior.
